title: Coin Change
description: Given coin denominations and an amount, return the fewest coins needed to make that amount (unlimited coins of each kind), or -1 if it cannot be made.

reference.use_case: Making an exact amount with the fewest pieces from a fixed set of sizes, such as dispensing cash with the fewest notes.
system_examples: ATMs and cash registers — dispensing an amount with the fewest notes or coins available
Cloud resource allocation — reaching a target capacity with the fewest instances of fixed sizes
Retail fulfillment — meeting an order quantity with the fewest standard-size packages
reference.explanation: Greedily taking the largest coin fails for arbitrary denominations (coins 1, 3, 4 for amount 6 gives 4+1+1 instead of 3+3), so build the minimum count for every amount up to the target: dp[a] = 1 + min(dp[a − c]), in O(amount × coins). This unbounded-knapsack DP applies whenever exact totals must be met with minimal units.
